description: Buddy Phase 31 — Code Review Fixes & Hardening. Addresses 6 blockers and top suggestions from Ralph code review sweep. Fixes: cycle_count NameError in continuous.py, wrong config type passed to ScannerAgentTeam, unguarded JSON parse in _update_pair_performance, silent except:pass blocks in observation logging, Path import guard in _spawn_background_retrain, cached fetch_live_nav to avoid 4x redundant API calls. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Fix cycle_count NameError in continuous.py _run_smart_loop
userStories.description: cycle_count is used at lines 948 and 1033 in _run_smart_loop but is never defined. This causes a NameError at runtime when agent degradation or observation consumer code paths are reached.
acceptanceCriteria: Define cycle_count from self._scan_count or a local counter in _run_smart_loop
cycle_count % 5 and % 10 checks work correctly
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Replaced cycle_count with self._scan_count at both locations (lines 948 and 1033). Tagged with US-186.

userStories.title: Fix ScannerAgentTeam wrong config type in continuous.py
userStories.description: At lines 579 and 1073, ScannerAgentTeam(self.config) passes ContinuousConfig instead of ScannerConfig. Should use self.scanner.config.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace self.config with self.scanner.config for ScannerAgentTeam construction
Both session snapshot save and weight decay use correct config
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Both ScannerAgentTeam(self.config) calls replaced with ScannerAgentTeam(self.scanner.config). Tagged with US-187.

userStories.title: Guard _update_pair_performance JSON parse in execution.py
userStories.description: Line 2603: json.loads(journal_path.read_text()) has no try/except. Corrupted JSON crashes the RL sync path.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap JSON parse in try/except with graceful return
Log warning on parse failure
Use safe_json_read if available
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Wrapped json.loads in try/except(json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) with logger.warning and return. Added isinstance(entries, list) guard.

userStories.title: Replace silent except:pass blocks in continuous.py observation logging
userStories.description: Multiple except Exception: pass blocks in continuous.py around observation logging hide real errors. Replace with logger.debug diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Find all bare except:pass blocks in continuous.py
Replace with logger.debug with contextual message
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Replaced 2 remaining bare except:pass blocks: dashboard formatting (line 288) and agent lifecycle observation (line 941). All others were already fixed with logging by prior sessions.

userStories.title: Ensure Path import in _spawn_background_retrain
userStories.description: _spawn_background_retrain at line 1375 uses Path() but relies on a local import that may be fragile. Ensure robust import.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify Path is imported before use in _spawn_background_retrain
Add from pathlib import Path if missing
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Local import 'from pathlib import Path' already added at line 1366 with US-190 tag.

userStories.title: Cache fetch_live_nav in execute_trade to avoid redundant API calls
userStories.description: execute_trade calls fetch_live_nav() up to 4 times per invocation. Cache the result for the duration of the method.
acceptanceCriteria: Single fetch_live_nav call at start of execute_trade
Reuse cached NAV value throughout
No behavior change on success path
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Single _cached_nav = self.fetch_live_nav() at line 954, reused at 3 position sizing locations (lines 990, 1000, 1020). Tagged with US-191.
